description: Broad Jainebooks discovery using semantic/domain search rather than literal Sthanakvasi keyword
methodology_note: Sources are classified by contextual relationship, not by keyword match. A source can be Jain/Svetambara/Sthanakvasi/other without requiring the literal word Sthanakvasi.

candidates.notes: Strongest confirmed Sthanakvasi practice source. English language makes it accessible for multilingual training.
